project_type: Python FastAPI backend - Autonomous AI Company Operating System
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml, Docker for full builds. Sandbox has Python 3.9 only, so use AST validation (python3 -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(f).read())') for syntax checks.
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode='auto'). Tests in tests/ directory. Uses unittest.mock (AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch). No real DB needed for unit tests.
build_command: python3 -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(f.read_text()) for f in pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.py')]" (AST validation since Python 3.12 not available on host)
test_command: python3 -c "import ast, pathlib; [ast.parse(f.read_text()) for f in pathlib.Path('tests').rglob('*.py')]" (AST validation for test files)
verification_instructions: 1. Run AST parse on all new source files to confirm Python 3.12 syntax is valid. 2. Run AST parse on all new test files. 3. Check imports are consistent with existing __init__.py patterns.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - sandbox has Python 3.9 for AST validation. Full tests require Python 3.12+ (available in Docker image python:3.12-slim).
environment_constraints: Python 3.9.25 in sandbox (project requires 3.12+). Cannot run pytest directly. Docker available for full builds. Use AST validation for syntax correctness. No new external deps beyond httpx (already in pyproject.toml).
contribution_requirements: No new external dependencies beyond httpx. All modules must have comprehensive tests. Follow existing patterns: dataclasses for models, async/await for I/O, type hints throughout, docstrings on all public classes/methods.
key_patterns: Adapters: extend BaseAdapter from nexus.adapters.base (validate_config, _do_create_session, _do_execute, _do_heartbeat, _do_terminate, _get_capabilities). Registry: AdapterRegistry._register_defaults() auto-registers all adapters. Orchestration: uses SubTask dataclass, LLM callable as Callable[[str], Awaitable[str]]. Templates: existing system uses Markdown files with YAML frontmatter in templates/agents/. Company module: dataclasses and manager classes. API routes: FastAPI APIRouter with CurrentCompanyId dependency.
directory_structure: src/nexus/ contains all source. Key subdirs: adapters/ (LLM provider adapters), orchestration/ (planning, routing, execution), templates/ (agent role templates with agents/ subdir for .md files), company/ (org management), api/routes/ (FastAPI routers), runtime/ (session, adapter protocol), models/ (SQLModel tables). tests/ is flat with test_*.py files.
